evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that guarantees a fast, reliable return frames stability and dependable craft as the appealed-to good.
The appeal is to durability and safety of work — conservation of what was produced, no loss.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Designing the agent's own choice of cadence — poll now or receive later — appeals to self-origination and mastery of the process.
